title: Benchmark store-and-forward latency (IHAVE to gossipsub publish)
description:
Measure the latency from receiving the last byte of an IHAVE article to the gossipsub publish call completing. This is the propagation latency. Use tokio::time::Instant. Measure p50/p99 over 1000 articles. Artifact: added to transit/benches/ihave_throughput.rs or separate file.

Acceptance criteria:
- p50 and p99 latency reported
- result identifies where time is spent (IPFS write vs log append vs gossipsub)
